Tobias, the depot is **Southgate**. In the Sept 3, 2025 war-room log for this channel, Priyanka wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she posted that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The only record I found is from that 2025 incident. Nothing in the channel or the GBrain notes gives a current site address or more detail on the 2026 outage, so check that before the call if it matters.
